units.source_text: 那以后，我就像是被论文折磨成了精神病似的，眼睛都熬红了。

en.t: After that, I suffered as though the thesis had driven me nearly mad, and my eyes were red from strain.

units.source_text: 我向一年前毕业的朋友详细打听了他们写论文时的情况。

en.t: I questioned friends who had graduated the year before in detail about how things had gone when they wrote their theses.

units.source_text: 其中一人告诉我，他是在交卷截止的那天，坐车赶到教务处才没有误了交卷的。

en.t: One of them told me that on the day the paper was due, he had taken a carriage to the administration office and only just managed not to miss the deadline.

units.source_text: 另一个人说，由于他迟到了一刻钟——应该是五点交去——才把论文送去，

en.t: Another said that because he brought his thesis in fifteen minutes late, though it was supposed to be handed in at five,

units.source_text: 险些被退回，多亏了主任教授的宽容，才交了论文。

en.t: it was almost refused, and he was able to submit it only thanks to the leniency of the supervising professor.

units.source_text: 他们的经验之谈愈加激励了惶惶不安的我，

en.t: Their accounts of experience further spurred on my anxious self,

units.source_text: 每日不是伏案奋笔疾书，就是钻进昏暗的书库，在那些高高的书架上寻找参考书。

en.t: and every day I either bent over my desk writing furiously, or slipped into the dim library stacks to search the tall shelves for reference books.

units.source_text: 我的眼睛就像收藏者发掘古董时那样搜索着书脊上的烫金字。

en.t: My eyes searched the gilt letters on the book spines the way a collector hunts out antiques.

units.source_text: 随着梅花绽放，寒风渐渐转向了南方。

en.t: As the plum blossoms opened, the cold wind gradually shifted toward the south.

units.source_text: 又过了些日子，渐渐开始传来樱花的花信了。

en.t: After some more days had passed, word of the cherry blossoms gradually began to reach us.

units.source_text: 然而，我仍旧像驾在辕上的马一样，被论文鞭策着，一直朝前跑。

en.t: Even so, like a horse harnessed between the shafts, I was still driven on by my thesis and kept running straight ahead.

units.source_text: 直到四月下旬，终于按预定时间完成了这篇论文。

en.t: At last, in late April, I completed the thesis on schedule.

units.source_text: 此前，我没有登过先生家的门槛。

en.t: Until then, I had not once crossed Sensei's threshold.
